messages:
raj: Quick sync — we need a solid routing plan for SOC/pen bundles to SI partners and marketplace listings. Who owns transfer, redaction, and audit trail? Wed 09:00 PT ok for a short sync?

linda: prefer S3->S3 ingestion with KMS envelopes, no raw presigned links in emails. :lock: keeps audit easy.

kevin: I can own the bundle creation (zip + manifest) and initial redaction pass.

maria: I will open the infra ticket to provision partner bucket + cross-account role. Assigning kevin as artifact owner by default.

jonathan: retention question — marketplace wants 1 year, security prefers 90 days. Can we TTL to 365 and auto-archive to Glacier, with a separate short-lived access window for partners?

linda: archive + TTL is fine, but redaction signoff must happen before the archive starts. Workflow: kevin redacts -> security review -> add audit record -> upload.

kevin: got it. what do you want in the manifest? need a schema to checksum-guarantee integrity.

linda: minimal manifest example (use JSON or YAML, whichever your toolchain prefers):
```
- bundle_id: <ISO8601-timestamp>
- files:
  - soc2_report.pdf (sha256:<hex>)
  - pen_test_summary.pdf (sha256:<hex>)
  - attachments/infra_diagram.png (sha256:<hex>)
- redaction_policy: tool=sops, rules=v1
- signed_by: <employee-email>
- owner: kevin@redwood.com
- retention_days: 365
- archival: glacier
```

security-bot: Audit note: new SOC snapshot available in Vault at https://vault.redwood.com/compliance/si-acme/2026-03-10. Access links expire in 7d. Please follow KMS transfer for external shares.

maria: action items to confirm now: 1) kevin generate and redacted bundle by Tue EOD; 2) linda create IAM role + KMS key and post ARN to the ticket; 3) jonathan confirm retention/archival policy with marketplace legal; 4) I'll schedule a 30m handshake with SI contact Daren for Wed 09:00 PT.

raj: sounds good. Also note we need a signed attestation from the SI that they will rotate access within 30 days and only use the bundle for listing verification. Maria, add that to the meeting agenda.

kevin: quick Q — do we keep a hash-only public index for the marketplace so partners can verify without receiving the file? That might reduce re-sharing.

linda: yes, publish a small index file with filenames + sha256 + bundle_id to s3://redwood-marketplace-index/ — index itself must be signed and immutable.

jonathan: I'll draft retention language for Legal: default 365 days, can request extensions with justification; auto-archive after 90 days for low-sensitivity items.

maria: created ticket #PRT-5421 and added initial checklist. Kept the IAM role request in the attachments.

raj: perfect. please paste final checklist/manifest example in the ticket and add the KMS ARN when available. We'll run the handshake Wed and close the loop. :thumbsup:
